note: When a WinForms control has no component in controls.json, the generator renders the closest available library component instead of a placeholder. Data only: edit or extend without rebuilding. `use` is a component name from controls.json; propertyAliases / eventAliases rename WinForms members to the ones that component's spec reads (code that uses `dt.Value` then reads the text box state).

fallbacks.note: list or tree shown as a flat list
slider shown as a progress bar
drop-down shown as a plain toolbar button

default.note: any other control (third-party, owner-drawn, a viewer): a panel when it has children, otherwise a label with its text (or its type name)
